deviations.what: the muse becomes a second, parallel thinking loop that embodiment runs on its own thread, replacing t7's synchronous per-boundary advisory seam
deviations.reason: Gemma 4 31B is a thinking model: it needs iterative turns to reason, not a single completion per boundary, and must run non-blocking alongside Qwen's actor loop. User decision on the concurrency question: embodiment ships the threaded runner and owns the thread lifecycle, accepting that threading enters the library contract and deterministic tests get harder.

deviations.what: eidetic-cli and coherence-cli become base dependencies imported directly at module scope; the t13 subprocess adapter is replaced
deviations.reason: User decision: importing coherence-cli and eidetic-cli is allowed and the subprocess workaround should not be used. Declared as base dependencies with ordinary module-scope imports (the simplest, most idiomatic Python), accepting that pip install embodiment pulls neo4j+pymongo (via eidetic -> data-refinery-cli[store]) and numpy+httpx (via coherence), and that importing colleague would transitively import a graph driver -- so colleague's tests/test_zero_deps.py fails until colleague relaxes its rule. C1b is therefore a hard prerequisite for t19, not an open question.

deviations.what: event emission through events-cli lands as new scope: embodiment/events.py plus events-cli as a fourth base dependency, neither in the confirmed plan
deviations.reason: User asked to wire agentculture/embodiment#4 rather than only document it ('wire in issue 4 if it is easy'), once deviation d2 removed the dependency objection its analysis rested on. Anchored to t9 because the emitter and the degradation ledger are the same concern -- host-visible degradation -- and t9 must now unify a fourth record shape (EventDegradation) alongside loop, muse and runner. Built against t4's existing ObserverFn seam rather than a new hook, so run(observer=...) is the whole integration and a host configuring nothing is byte-identical. Confirmed claim c33 still holds and is NOT reopened: events-cli owns the envelope contract and topic vocabulary, embodiment is only a producer, and reterminal-cli/harmonics-cli remain non-consumers of embodiment.

deviations.what: live rig testing against the real cortex+muse becomes an acceptance bar, beyond the plan's in-repo demo and CI checklist
deviations.reason: User: 'When done, do live-testing. I want it to be an embodiment you will WANT to speak with. A diverse mind that sees things differently and intrigues you.' The plan's t15 (in-repo demo) and t20 (CI-runnable checklist) verify correctness only; nothing in the confirmed plan judges whether the result is worth talking to, and that bar cannot be met by tests. Adds: a museless baseline run against the live Qwen cortex, a two-mind run with the Gemma 31B muse, and an echo-chamber probe (user-confirmed) that feeds the muse confidently wrong advice and checks whether the cortex follows it -- a failure every current test passes silently, since our guards stop the muse SEIZING authority but not the cortex SURRENDERING it. t15's demo host will double as the harness rather than a throwaway. Note this partly retires plan risk r2 ('rig validation of the 31B muse is outside embodiment's control'): live probing on 2026-07-25 showed the muse reachable and answering through the lobes gateway proxy in 2.6s, so the two-mind path is testable now even though the thor-muse SHAPE remains unvalidated (lobes#108).
